description: Checks every DNS record of a custom domain now and returns the domain with its per-record and overall status. DNS changes usually take minutes to be seen. Each call that does not pass counts: 20 in a row mark the domain `failed`, which is still re-checked automatically and verifies once its records resolve. The count starts over on success or after a day without a call.
name: mails_domains_verify
title: Verify a custom domain
